content:
One thing I've noticed about your contributions that they have nice formatting and case coverage from the start. But won't it be better to set it as WIP so the community can raise suggestions for improvement, if there is any?

By the way, please set 'Line 1' and 'Next [[h]] lines' in the input to <<bold>>, as well as the 'One line' in the output please. Thank you.
Thanks! I have applied the requested bold formatting and moved the contribution to WIP. I also reordered the tests to cover more varied cases early and aligned each validator with its public test.

Goal
* Please replace the third paragraph with the following:

<<Valid tree>>

• A valid tree has at least one crown row and at least one trunk row.

• The crown starts with a width of {{1}}. Each subsequent crown row must be {{2}} characters wider than the previous crown row. Thus, the crown widths start with {{1}}, {{3}}, {{5}}, …. The crown may stop after any number of rows.

• Every trunk row must have width {{1}}.

* The input guarantee in the Goal section isn't clear enough for players to determine what they need to check in their solution. In addition, the checks that *are required* should be explained *before* the checks that are not required.

Therefore, please remove the second paragraph, and add the following at the end (i.e. below the "… print INVALID" sentence).

<<The following are guaranteed, and checking them is not required in your code:>>

For every row containing {{@}} or {{#}}:

• A row contains either {{@}} or {{#}}, never both.

• All {{@}} and {{#}} characters form one contiguous block, both horizontally and vertically.

• The block is horizontally centered within the picture.

• All crown rows appear above all trunk rows.

* Please change "If valid" to "If the given picture contains a valid tree".

Cases
* Please swap "Only one trunk row (test)" with "Only one trunk row (validator)".

* Spaces and other background characters (test): Please include non-space background characters in the input picture.

* In the input picture of the last two INVALID case pairs, please replace the "." background with two other characters.

* The crown fills the width (test and validator):

  • Add a variety of random characters to the background of the input picture for the final case pair.

  • Please replace the final two rows with non-trunk characters in the input picture.

Thanks.

Thanks! I updated the Goal as suggested, with the validity rules before the explicit input guarantees. I also swapped the single-trunk test and validator, added non-space background characters, replaced the dot backgrounds in the last two INVALID pairs, and varied the backgrounds in the full-width pair. Its last two rows are now background-only, and both expected outputs were recalculated. All 16 tests and 16 validators pass in the IDE with the Python reference solution.
